entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane similar to Hellenic Greece governed by the gods of Nyx, where heroes face monsters and belief shapes reality.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: A mystical realm tied to dreams and the night sky where the gods dwell.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The subterranean realm of the dead, ruled by Erebos, where the titans were sealed.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Horrific primal urges made flesh that roamed Theros before the gods and were sealed in the Underworld.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The god of fate and destiny who volunteered to act as an eternal jailer sealing the titans in the Underworld.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: An oldest god who enacted the Silence of the Gods.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god who fights Elspeth, imprisons Daxos' fate, and is later compleated and killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the dead who rules the Underworld and imprisons Heliod.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The god of the hunt who alone was aware of Xenagos' threat and shot an arrowhead into him.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A god who equipped the heroes who overthrew Agnomakhos and survived the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: The most notable Archon tyrant, who used the leonin as an army.

entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: A human hero inspired by Ephara who helped overthrow Agnomakhos and found Meletis.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: A human hero inspired by Ephara who helped overthrow Agnomakhos and found Meletis.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis founded by Kynaios and Tiro, the last bastion against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker who ascended to godhood on Theros and was killed by Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who defeats Xenagos, is empowered in the Underworld, defeats Heliod and ascends.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps Elspeth and later, compleated, leads the Phyrexian invasion of Theros.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: An oracle and Elspeth's lover whom Heliod transforms into his demigod champion.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who equips Elspeth with a weapon made from her past traumas in the Underworld.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A nyxborn sent by Klothys to bring Elspeth back whose spark ignites.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who kills the compleated Heliod.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: The event enacted by Kruphix that forced the deities to remain in Nyx without interfering with mortals.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who compleated the gods' devotees and most of the gods.

entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: A titan whose voiding maw obliterated the Phyrexian invaders in the Underworld.

events.summary: The gods, born from mortal prayer, seal the titans away in the Underworld with Klothys as eternal jailer.
events.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

events.summary: Ephara inspires Kynaios and Tiro to overthrow the Archon tyrant Agnomakhos and found Meletis.
events.quote: Ephara inspired and equipped the human heroes Kynaios and Tiro to overthrow Agnomakhos.

events.summary: Xenagos attacks the poleis with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods, and Kruphix enacts the Silence of the Gods.
events.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

events.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood through the forced worship of a Great Revel after the siege of Akros, and Elspeth is scapegoated and exiled.
events.quote: Using the forced worhsip of mortal revelers, Xenagos managed to ascend to godhood.

events.summary: Elspeth throws her spear into Xenagos' chest, exploding the arrowhead Nylea shot into him and killing him.
events.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

events.summary: Elspeth offers her life for Daxos; Erebos accepts and Heliod fatally wounds his former champion.
events.quote: Elspeth offered her life in trade for her lover Daxos .

events.summary: Heliod makes Daxos his champion to purge the other gods from Meletis, starting a war of the gods and opening rifts to the Underworld.
Elspeth, empowered by Ashiok, escapes the Underworld to assassinate Heliod.
events.quote: Elspeth became empowered by Ashiok , who equipped her with a weapon created from her past traumas

events.summary: Elspeth's Shadowspear is acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod's spear shatters, and Erebos imprisons Heliod in the Underworld forever.
events.quote: Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever

events.summary: Elspeth planeswalks away with Calix, whose spark ignites.
events.quote: Elspeth planeswalked away, with Calix, whose spark ignited in the meantime, following her.

events.summary: A Phyrexian Ajani Goldmane leads the first wave of the invasion against temples, and compleating devotees leads to compleating gods.
events.quote: compleating the gods' devotees meant that the gods themselves

events.summary: Most gods are compleated while Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid, and Kroxa obliterates invaders in the Underworld.
events.quote: The city of Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

events.summary: Kaya Cassir kills the distracted compleated Heliod as New Capenna's angels counter-invade.
events.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya Cassir
